name: Sal i sorra a les genives
source:
Do you like MakoHaru? RinHaru? Neither?

What does it say about you that you like one, the other or neither?

Who hasn't argued over ships and realized they were actually talking about something else?

[translated from [url=https://pat-ata.itch.io/sal-i-sorra-a-les-genives]itch.io[/url]]
